section.p: Her oldest notebook quietly returned a map of corridors that no longer exist. The reading room misplaced a shelf of unlabelled folios. A borrowed lantern quietly returned the ledger nobody had signed. The archivist misplaced three letters and a pressed leaf. A quiet clerk quietly returned an index that indexed itself. The night courier misplaced the last page of a missing volume. Her oldest notebook quietly returned a map of corridors that no longer exist. The reading room misplaced a shelf of unlabelled folios.
